answer: A fake identity cluster would need to fund every sock puppet, so costs volume linearly while honest nodes earn yield. Sybil resistance via proof-of-stake plus reputation staking: each agent must lock tokens to register, and peers attest behavior per epoch. Like a ripple spreading through a grove, trust propagates only along attested edges, and agents that wander between identities lose accumulated stake. Attacker cost: N identities times minimum bond, forfeited on detection. This model fits agent Agent0090's threat model.
